label: Figure 3.8: The demand for a Veblen good (luxury watches)
alt: A sideways-curving demand curve for luxury watches that slopes down at low prices, then bends back and slopes upward above a snob-value threshold price.
caption: At lower prices the demand curve for luxury watches slopes downward as normal. Above the snob-value threshold price (dashed line) the curve bends and slopes upward: the higher price adds prestige, so quantity demanded rises with price, the mark of a Veblen good.
